sentences.text:
THIS CRIMINAL PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
CORAM: THE HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE J.M.KHAZI  ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE J.M.KHAZI) No representation for the petitioner even in the afternoon session.
On 27.08.2024, as a last chance, time was granted with a condition precedent that, on the next date of hearing if petitioner's counsel fails to address arguments, necessary orders would be passed.
2. It appears that petitioner is not interested in prosecuting the petition.
Hence, petition is dismissed for non prosecution.
